[excited] Wait… who actually MADE this game?
Every Roblox game starts as an empty baseplate in Roblox Studio.
Builders place thousands of parts to make the map.
3D artists model every brainrot, pet and item.
Scripters code everything in Luau. Every steal, every coin… is code.
Servers save your progress, so your brainrots are still there tomorrow.
Then test, fix bugs, and update. Every. Single. Week.
[excited] Grow a Garden's first version took three days… then twenty-one million people played at once!
[excited] So next time you steal a brainrot… respect the dev.
